targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pilot_onboarding_runs WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM onboarding_approval_requests WHERE status = 'pending'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telemetry_onboarding_pressure WHERE pressure_level = 'critical'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pilot_health_validations WHERE check_passed = false
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pilot_rollback_validations WHERE verdict = 'fail'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operator_readiness_reviews WHERE operator_ready = true
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as time, AVG(events_per_second) as eps, MAX(events_per_second) as max_eps FROM telemetry_onboarding_pressure GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as time, metric_name, AVG(metric_value) as avg_value FROM pilot_success_metrics GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE health_ok) as healthy, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT health_ok) as degraded FROM pilot_observation_windows GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
